title: Hall photon theory, copyrighted 1997 and inspired by faster-than-light craft
summary: Charles Hall tells of Hall photon theory, copyrighted 1997 and inspired by faster-than-light craft, about 1997 at Nevada (based on Indian Springs sightings), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I first copyrighted whole photon theory in 1997

plain: Charles Hall says he spent three years in Nevada, near Indian Springs, around tall, white-skinned beings he calls the Tall Whites, and watched their craft move in ways he believes were faster than light. He says this inspired his own physics idea, which he calls whole photon theory, and that he first copyrighted it in 1997, writing it up in books such as Beyond Relativity and Mirage Galaxies and Edges in Space. If true, his theory would be a human attempt to explain how those craft travel.
